subject: Clarifying invoice delivery + split billing contacts
messages:
From: Sarah Kemp <ap-payments@stellarhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: finance@stellarhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice delivery preference + PO 67821

Hi Laura,

We have PO 67821 for Redwood’s July usage and are preparing to process the invoice. Before we do, quick question on your preferred delivery and contact set up: do you prefer we (1) push PDF invoices to invoices@redwood.com and copy a secondary contact, or (2) upload invoices to your billing portal and send email notifications to a small AP distribution list?

Two additional items:
- We need a VAT number on the invoice for our EU entity (we got the sample invoice attached).
- Can you confirm the billing owner for this PO? Our practice is to route to one team for payment collection and a separate team for cost-allocation details — if Redwood can receive invoices at one address and route internally that’s fine, otherwise we’ll split delivery between two contacts.

Attaching a sample invoice and the PO for reference.

Thanks,
Sarah Kemp
Accounts Payable Lead
StellarHealth
Attachments: StellarHealth_sample_invoice_2026-07.pdf, PO-67821.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kemp <ap-payments@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference + PO 67821

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending these. Quick answers:

1) Preferred flow: send the PDF invoice to invoices@redwood.com. That inbox is monitored by Finance and will trigger ingestion into our AP system. We can also accept uploads to the billing portal but that typically adds a day to processing on your side.

2) VAT: please include StellarHealth’s EU VAT on the invoice line for cross-checking. If you need our VAT (EU) we’ll provide it below.

3) Billing owner: for payment collection route invoices@redwood.com. For cost allocation / internal tagging please add cost-center@redwood.com on Cc and we’ll split internally. If you prefer, we can provide a single-person contact for AP follow-ups.

I’m looping in Marissa (billing ops) and Ben (finance) to confirm the ingestion behavior and whether you should include a structured metadata header (PO number field) in the PDF.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura — quick technical details from Billing Ops:

- invoices@redwood.com is processed automatically and can accept PDF attachments or a simple email body with an embedded invoice. If StellarHealth includes the PO number in the subject line (e.g., "PO 67821 - Redwood"), our parser will tag it correctly.
- For portal uploads: we support CSV/UBL ingestion but portal ingestion requires a manual step on your side to mark the invoice "ready for collection" which can delay processing by 24-48 hours.
- If you DO want us to split delivery to two separate mailboxes (payments@redwood.com for AP, cost-center@redwood.com for allocation), we can set up a forwarding rule. That is usually the cleanest for companies that need separate receivable tracking.

Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference + PO 67821

Sarah — if StellarHealth can send PDF invoices to invoices@redwood.com with the PO in the subject, we’ll be able to pay on our standard NET30 terms. A couple of requests to avoid delays:

- Include the vendor address and tax ID (for cross-border VAT handling).
- If StellarHealth requires remittance to a separate banking profile, please include bank account details on the invoice or a remittance advice PDF.

If you prefer portal-only delivery for compliance reasons, we will accept portal uploads but request an email notification to invoices@redwood.com so our AP can pick it up immediately.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Finance
Redwood Inference
